SbtCosmo.Derivation.GroundFiniteNativeTransport.step.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [PseudoMetricSpace α] (f : α → α)
  {c next x : α} {r nextRadius defect : ℝ} {M : NNReal} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hL : LipschitzOnWith M f (Metric.closedBall c r))
  (hdefect : dist (f c) next ≤ defect) (hbudget : ↑M * r + defect ≤ nextRadius) (hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r) :
  f x ∈ Metric.closedBall next nextRadius
SbtCosmo.Derivation.GroundFiniteNativeTransport.enclosed.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [PseudoMetricSpace α] (f : α → α) {N : ℕ}
  (centres : Fin (N + 1) → α) (radii : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ) (rates : Fin N → NNReal) (defects : Fin N → ℝ) {initial : α}
  (hr : ∀ (j : Fin (N + 1)), 0 ≤ radii j)
  (hL : ∀ (j : Fin N), LipschitzOnWith (rates j) f (Metric.closedBall (centres j.castSucc) (radii j.castSucc)))
  (hdefect : ∀ (j : Fin N), dist (f (centres j.castSucc)) (centres j.succ) ≤ defects j)
  (hbudget : ∀ (j : Fin N), ↑(rates j) * radii j.castSucc + defects j ≤ radii j.succ)
  (hi : initial ∈ Metric.closedBall (centres 0) (radii 0)) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
  f^[↑i] initial ∈ Metric.closedBall (centres i) (radii i)

  {x c target : α} {r d : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r) (hcentre : dist c target ≤ d) : dist x target ≤ r + d
